'''2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner received a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Date:''' May 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, Nevada

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam Brian Garrison Las Vegas Grand Slam Rops Deck]] ([[Brian Garrison]], [[Dark]]; 2–1) — "the Rallitir Operations deck that I used at the Las Vegas Grand Slam"
* [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam Tim Guzman Info Brokers LS Vegas Slam Deck]] ([[Tim Guzman]], [[Light]]; 4th) — "It helped me get 4th place at the slam"
